decisions.thought: Mirror match: lead Garchomp for Stealth Rock with Focus Sash, break with Earthquake/Scale Shot. Save Mega Dragonite to Dragon Dance mid-game, Kingambit as Supreme Overlord late cleaner with Sucker Punch. Watch for Rotom-Wash burns and Mimikyu Disguise.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon team composition and lead choice for mirror matchup with hazard control and coverage tradeoffs.

decisions.thought: Lead matchup favors us. Set Stealth Rock to break foe Dragonite Multiscale, Mimikyu Disguise, and mirror Sashes, then Earthquake Kingambit twice. Save Mega Dragonite to Dragon Dance mid-game; Kingambit cleans late with Sucker Punch. Watch for Rotom-Wash burns and levitating switch-ins to Earthquake.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage for Garchomp Earthquake versus Kingambit under abstract output constraints.

decisions.thought: Rocks up. Garchomp at 38% will die to next Kowtow, so Earthquake now for huge super-effective damage on Kingambit, likely leaving it in Extreme Speed range. Then Mega Dragonite finishes it and can Dragon Dance; our Kingambit cleans late with Supreme Overlord boost after Garchomp falls.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Garchomp vs Kingambit damage and KO chances to decide on an EQ trade versus switching to Dragonite.Calculating EQ damage range and Supreme Overlord interaction to weigh sacrificing Garchomp versus switching.

decisions.thought: Rocks up, Garchomp fell giving Kingambit Supreme Overlord boost later. Opponent Kingambit at 75%, revealed Kowtow/Sucker. Send Dragonite: Multiscale intact, Earthquake should KO Kingambit; Sucker fails on switch. Save our Kingambit as late cleaner. Watch unknown two teammates, rocks will chip them.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokemon type matchups and move effectiveness to choose between Dragonite and Kingambit for the switch.

decisions.thought: Rocks up, Garchomp down. Dragonite Multiscale intact vs Kingambit 75%; Earthquake likely falls short unboosted and eats Sucker Punch. Dragon Dance now: Sucker fails, then +1 Earthquake KOs. Save Mega for attacking turn, Kingambit as late cleaner. Unknown two foes will take rock chip.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations for Dragonite versus Kingambit and Mega Dragonite stats uncertainty.Comparing Dragon Dance and Mega EQ options against Sucker Punch priority and Multiscale damage reduction.

decisions.thought: Rocks up, Garchomp down. Dragonite +1 Atk/Spe at 68%, Multiscale gone. +1 Earthquake should KO opposing Kingambit (75%, same build) without Mega; save Mega for next attacker. Then assess unknown teammates chipped by rocks; our Kingambit remains healthy late cleaner with Sucker Punch.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating a Dragonite KO calculation and mega evolution tradeoff for the next move.Confirming the KO is guaranteed against the mirrored Kingambit and weighing the mega evolution ability uncertainty.

decisions.thought: Rocks up, Garchomp down. Our Dragonite +1 Atk/Spe at 68%, Mega available; opposing Dragonite 75% with Multiscale broken by rocks, opposing Kingambit fainted. Dragon Claw should KO before its Claw; watch Extreme Speed chip. One unknown foe remains—possible Mimikyu/Gholdengo switch resists Dragon. Save Kingambit (100%) as late cleaner with Sucker Punch/Iron Head.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage for Dragon Claw against 75% HP Dragonite under level 50 stats and Multiscale status.Extending the damage check to account for Mega evolution and priority moves.

decisions.thought: Rocks up; Garchomp and foe Kingambit/Dragonite down. Our Mega Dragonite +1 Atk/Spe at 68% vs Gholdengo 93%. +1 Earthquake should KO; if Focus Sash, survive its special hit then Dragon Claw finishes. Kingambit 100% backup cleans up with Kowtow/Iron Head/Sucker.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Calculating damage for +1 Mega Dragonite Earthquake vs Gholdengo under abstract battle constraints.Evaluating item and type interactions to confirm the KO outcome.
